structured_checks.checks: Revision 3 (round-2 review): no clause names a scripts_ini side or file as a prefix, so nothing under it is covered wholesale. Each side's presence, encoding facts (BOM, width, CR/LF counts, total bytes, fallback codec) and config shape, the single trigger section's entry count, script, parameters, raw line and both split properties, and the absence of psscripts.ini are asserted leaf by leaf; any other section (an extra populated Startup or Logoff trigger) adds facts no clause predicts and disproves the run.

Revision 1 left the user-side tool half unasserted and measured it (estate window 19, w19-r2: {40B66650-...}). Revision 2 asserts both extension lists as the exact measured strings, absent before, so any extra group, a different tool half on either side, or a list GPME rewrote disproves the run.

Both version halves must move up (>), not by an asserted step: GPME's per-dialog bump has not been measured for two sheets in one session. The packed relation versionNumber = user*65536 + machine is asserted against both the GPT.INI-derived and the AD-read value.

No PowerShell entry is authored and the ordering dropdown is never touched, so both psscripts.ini sides must carry config_shape 'none' (true whether or not GPME writes the file); whether it writes one is recorded, not asserted.

scripts.ini bytes are not hashed by the observers (system relpaths), so cleanup runs gpo_backup_owned: Backup-GPO of the OWNED GUID into a new leaf directory under the fixed C:\gpo-studio\wcd-backup root, before removal, emitting each INI's sha256, byte length and attributes into the cleanup journal. The record therefore binds the bytes the operator later collects.
Every relative path in post.scope.sysvol_relpaths stays under this GPO's GUID directory. Backs the sysvol_contained fact the declarative forbid consumes; computed by the observer, asserted here.

Revision 2 pins the exact pre and post scope.sysvol_relpaths lists measured by w19-r2 (the two scripts.ini files plus the Scripts trigger directories and User/Documents & Settings GPME lays down while browsing), and requires no psscripts.ini on either side.

Cleanup removes and backs up only the GPO whose GUID setup captured from New-GPO ({out.setup.gpo.guid}); a setup that never created one (an existing name is refused) removes nothing. Never by display name.

Both scripts.ini files are pinned byte-for-byte through the file_digest observer: absent before, then exactly expected_<side>_ini_bytes long with SHA-256 expected_<side>_ini_sha256 (the window-19/20 measurement). The arguments carry the values, and the record's invocation field binds them.
